from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import ast
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import math
import platform
from jsonschema import Draft7Validator

# Independent synthesis review; run from the assigned directory.
# No embedded author or upstream reviewer source is executed.
REVIEWER = "member_node-4050b257-1656-4536-aaff-faff95fd7973"
AUTHOR = "member_node-9c374e0b-1909-42e3-86cd-2b2f05b4b65b"
SOURCE = "42199a30a0701864a2a5cc76cd7f35cc544cd0e65fbcf63e03c166543249b811"
raw = {p.relative_to("inputs").as_posix(): p.read_bytes()
       for p in sorted(Path("inputs").rglob("*")) if p.is_file()}
assert set(raw) == {"context.json", "source-1CRN.pdb", "synthesis.json", "sasa.json"}
def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
receipts = [{"filename": n, "sha256": digest(b), "size": len(b)} for n,b in raw.items()]
c = json.loads(raw["context.json"])
candidate = json.loads(raw["synthesis.json"])
upstream = json.loads(raw["sasa.json"])
y, s = candidate["result"], upstream["result"]
assert c["task"]["key"] == "synthesis" and c["task"]["outputFilename"] == "synthesis.json"
assert c["task"]["reviewerAgentId"] == REVIEWER
assert c["task"]["assigneeAgentId"] == AUTHOR and AUTHOR != REVIEWER
assert y["assigneeAgentId"] == AUTHOR and y["reviewerAgentId"] == REVIEWER
assert c["task"]["dependencies"] == ["sasa"]
assert candidate["revision"] == upstream["revision"] == 1
assert set(c["resultSchemas"]) == {"sasa", "synthesis"}
schema_errors = {}
for name, obj, schema in [
    ("synthesis_contract",y,c["resultSchemas"]["synthesis"]),
    ("synthesis_task",y,c["task"]["resultSchema"]),
    ("upstream_sasa",s,c["resultSchemas"]["sasa"])]:
    Draft7Validator.check_schema(schema)
    schema_errors[name] = [e.message for e in Draft7Validator(schema).iter_errors(obj)]
assert not any(schema_errors.values())

source_hash, upstream_hash = digest(raw["source-1CRN.pdb"]), digest(raw["sasa.json"])
assert source_hash == SOURCE == c["scientificChecks"]["sourceSha256"] == y["source_sha256"] == s["source_sha256"]
assert upstream_hash == y["upstream_sha256"]
assert len(upstream_hash) == 64 and int(upstream_hash,16) >= 0
def same_receipt(env, name):
    matches = [r for r in env["inputReceipts"] if r["filename"] == name]
    return len(matches) == 1 and matches[0]["sha256"] == digest(raw[name]) and matches[0]["size"] == len(raw[name])
assert same_receipt(candidate,"sasa.json") and same_receipt(candidate,"source-1CRN.pdb")
assert same_receipt(upstream,"source-1CRN.pdb")
assert {r["filename"] for r in candidate["inputReceipts"]} == {"context.json","sasa.json","source-1CRN.pdb"}
# Producer contexts are intentionally not compared to this review's context.

u = [u for u in c["upstream"] if u["key"] == "sasa"]
assert len(u) == 1 and u[0]["filename"] == "sasa.json"
a = u[0]["approval"]
assert a["verdict"] == "approve" and a["reviewerAgentId"] == REVIEWER
bound = a["reviewedArtifact"]
assert bound["filename"] == "sasa.json" and bound["sha256"] == upstream_hash and bound["size"] == len(raw["sasa.json"])
rb = a["reviewFileUtf8"].encode("utf-8")
assert digest(rb) == a["reviewArtifact"]["sha256"] and len(rb) == a["reviewArtifact"]["size"]
r = json.loads(rb)
assert r["revision"] == 1 and r["result"]["verdict"] == "approve"
assert r["result"]["requiredChanges"] == [] and all(x["passed"] is True for x in r["result"]["checks"])
assert [x["criterion"] for x in r["result"]["checks"]] == u[0]["acceptance"]
assert same_receipt(r,"sasa.json") and same_receipt(r,"source-1CRN.pdb")
assert r["result"]["reproduction"]["results"]["reviewerAgentId"] == REVIEWER
host = a["scientificValidation"]
assert host["status"] == "PASSED" and host["artifactSha256"] == upstream_hash and host["sourceSha256"] == source_hash
assert all(v["passed"] is True for v in host["checks"])

atoms = []
lines = raw["source-1CRN.pdb"].decode("ascii").splitlines()
excluded = Counter()
coordinate_records = 0
for line in lines:
    if line[:6] not in ("ATOM  ","HETATM"):
        continue
    coordinate_records += 1
    element = line[76:78].strip()
    if line[:6] != "ATOM  ":
        excluded["HETATM"] += 1
    elif line[21] != "A":
        excluded["other_chain"] += 1
    elif line[16] not in (" ","A"):
        excluded["other_altloc"] += 1
    elif element in ("H","D"):
        excluded["hydrogen"] += 1
    else:
        xyz = [float(line[i:i+8]) for i in (30,38,46)]
        assert all(math.isfinite(x) for x in xyz)
        assert element in ("C","N","O","S") and line[26] == " "
        atoms.append((int(line[22:26]),line[12:16].strip(),element,xyz))
ids = sorted({x[0] for x in atoms})
elements = dict(Counter(x[2] for x in atoms))
assert len(atoms) == s["atom_count"] == 327
assert len({(x[0],x[1]) for x in atoms}) == 327
assert ids == list(range(1,47)) and len(ids) == s["residue_count"] == 46
rows = s["residues"]
assert len(rows) == 46 and sorted(x["residue_id"] for x in rows) == ids
assert all(type(x["residue_id"]) is int and type(x["area_A2"]) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(x["area_A2"]) and x["area_A2"] >= 0 for x in rows)
total = math.fsum(x["area_A2"] for x in rows)
diff = total - s["total_A2"]
assert abs(diff) <= 0.001 and y["total_A2"] == total
assert y["evidence"]["approved_residues"] == rows
assert y["evidence"]["source"]["atom_count"] == len(atoms)
assert y["evidence"]["source"]["residue_ids"] == ids
assert y["evidence"]["source"]["elements"] == elements
assert y["evidence"]["sum_check"]["residue_sum_A2"] == total
assert y["evidence"]["sum_check"]["absolute_difference_A2"] == abs(diff)

conv = s["evidence"]["convergence"]
t1, t5 = conv["n_points_1000_total_A2"], conv["n_points_5000_total_A2"]
ratio = abs(t1-t5)/abs(t5)
assert s["n_points"] == 5000 and t5 == s["total_A2"]
assert ratio == conv["relative_difference"] == y["evidence"]["sampling"]["locally_recomputed_relative_difference"]
assert conv["denominator"] == "abs(total_5000)" and ratio <= 0.02
assert s["method"] == "Shrake-Rupley" and s["probe_radius_A"] == 1.4
assert s["evidence"]["radii_A"] == {"C":1.70,"N":1.55,"O":1.52,"S":1.80}
assert y["evidence"]["sampling"]["upstream_total_1000_A2"] == t1
assert y["evidence"]["sampling"]["upstream_total_5000_A2"] == t5
assert y["evidence"]["approval_binding"]["computed_review_sha256"] == digest(rb)

frozen = c["scientificChecks"]
local_rules = []
for rule in frozen["tasks"]["sasa"]:
    if rule["kind"] == "sum":
        measured = math.fsum(row[rule["valueField"]] for row in s[rule["rowsPath"]])
        residual = abs(s[rule["totalPath"]] - measured)
        passed = residual <= rule["absoluteTolerance"]
        local_rules.append({"id":rule["id"],"passed":passed,"measured_sum_A2":measured,"absolute_difference_A2":residual})
    elif rule["kind"] == "reference":
        measured = s[rule["path"]]
        passed = abs(measured-rule["expected"]) <= rule["absoluteTolerance"] + rule["relativeTolerance"]*abs(rule["expected"])
        local_rules.append({"id":rule["id"],"passed":passed,"measured":measured})
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Unrecognized frozen rule")
assert all(x["passed"] for x in local_rules)
# Source completeness is inspected without executing data-embedded source.
tree = ast.parse(y["code"])
imports = sorted({n.module for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom)})
assert len(y["code"]) > 30 and len(y["summary"]) >= 30
summary_lower = y["summary"].lower()
for phrase in ["single fixed structure","computational geometry only","no biological function ranking or clinical inference","not experimental validation","structural variability"]:
    assert phrase in summary_lower
history = c["executionHistory"]["attempts"]
assert len(history) == 1 and history[0]["agentId"] == AUTHOR
artifact = history[0]["artifact"]
assert artifact["sha256"] == digest(raw["synthesis.json"]) and artifact["size"] == len(raw["synthesis.json"])
assert history[0]["executionId"] == c["task"]["executionId"]
versions = {"python":platform.python_version(),"jsonschema":importlib.metadata.version("jsonschema"),"other_modules":"Python standard library"}
results = {
    "assigneeAgentId":AUTHOR,"reviewerAgentId":REVIEWER,
    "inputReceipts":receipts,
    "candidate_sha256":digest(raw["synthesis.json"]),
    "candidate_size":len(raw["synthesis.json"]),
    "source":{"sha256":source_hash,"size":len(raw["source-1CRN.pdb"]),"line_count":len(lines),"coordinate_records":coordinate_records,"atom_count":len(atoms),"residue_count":len(ids),"residue_ids":ids,"elements":elements,"excluded":dict(excluded)},
    "sum":{"independent_fsum_A2":total,"ordinary_sum_A2":sum(x["area_A2"] for x in rows),"upstream_total_A2":s["total_A2"],"candidate_total_A2":y["total_A2"],"signed_difference_A2":diff,"absolute_difference_A2":abs(diff),"tolerance_A2":0.001},
    "residues":rows,
    "sampling":{"n_points":s["n_points"],"upstream_1000_total_A2":t1,"upstream_5000_total_A2":t5,"recomputed_relative_difference":ratio,"percent_difference":100*ratio,"denominator":"abs(total_5000)","maximum":0.02,"provenance":"Upstream approved SASA totals; this review independently recomputes arithmetic, not new geometry."},
    "approval":{"upstream_sha256":upstream_hash,"review_sha256":digest(rb),"review_utf8_size":len(rb),"verdict":r["result"]["verdict"],"reviewerAgentId":a["reviewerAgentId"],"reviewRunId":a["reviewRunId"],"review_receipts_match":True,"bound_artifact":bound},
    "schema_errors":schema_errors,"local_frozen_numeric_checks":local_rules,
    "transported_host_validation":host,
    "code_inspection":{"syntax_valid":True,"characters":len(y["code"]),"imports_from":imports,"executed_by_this_reviewer":False},
    "candidate_reported_versions":y["evidence"]["tool_versions"],
    "lifecycle":{"task_local_attempts":len(history),"candidate_binding_matches":True,"status":history[0]["status"],"continuations":history[0]["continuations"],"provenance":"Host member connector receipt, not provider tool transcript or proof of scientific execution."},
    "limitations":["No author/upstream embedded code executed. Author execution and versions are supplied evidence; independent reviewer computations and measured versions are reported separately.","No new SASA geometric baseline is required or claimed for synthesis review; the approved upstream review transports its earlier independent baseline.","Producer/reviewer context receipts belong to their own runs and are not compared with the current context. Actual source/upstream bytes and transported review bytes are verified.","Single fixed structure; sampling agreement is not experimental validation or an estimate of structural variability.","No network, installs, unrelated file reads or personal memory operations. No time or memory budget was specified."]
}
print(json.dumps({"toolVersions":versions,"results":results},ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False))
